## Summary

I updated the customer code format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`.

**`AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java`** — the single place that builds the code:
- Added a `CITY3` prefix (upper-cased first three letters of the city).

The new-format acceptance test (`customerCode` matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`) and the full suite are green.
